result:
Here's how I read the spec. Members who book a lane get a text at 18:00 the evening before, so fewer lanes sit empty while people on the waiting list miss out. Anyone who ticked "no texts, please" gets no texts from the club.

What I found in the booking app:
- Nothing sends reminders yet. The club already texts its newsletter through an SMS provider, so the reminder can go out the same way.
- 23% of members have "no texts" ticked. Under rule 2, they would get no reminder at all.
- 61% of members have no email address, so email can't simply replace texts for everyone.

Have I got that right? Tell me if anything's off.

The most important open question is what happens for the "no texts" members. They're nearly a quarter of the club, so a lot of booked lanes could still go unused. There are three options:

- **No reminder for them.** This follows the spec exactly and is simplest, but it does nothing about no-shows from those members.
- **Email them if they have an address.** This keeps rule 2 and reaches some of them. I haven't checked how many "no texts" members have an email on file. I can look that up.
- **Count reminders as part of their booking**, so they're sent even to "no texts" members. This only works if the club is happy that the form's wording allows it.

I'd go with email where there's an address. Which do you want?

Or if you'd rather I just dive in, say so.
